lessons.claim: A fitted decay length is an implementation_check only in the window where the imposed law actually holds. At l_g = 13.375 d the CS hydrostatic profile fits 15.442 d over the dense window (+15.5 %) and 13.50 d over the tail (+0.9 %), so a 5 % check against the imposed value FAILS on a correct run in the first window -- a rule 7' error. Write the window beside the role; if the imposed value is not right over the whole range, the observable splits.
